camel_example: aliyun live StopLiveMPUTask --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId yourTaskId --AppId yourAppId
description_en: Stops a stream mixing and relay task
kebab_example: aliyun live stop-live-mpu-task --app-id yourAppId --task-id yourTaskId --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopLiveMPUTask

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Only a single ID is supported. The ID can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and can be up to 64 characters in length. You can view your application IDs by choosing ApsaraVideo Live > Live+ > ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication > Applications in the console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大64字符。通过访问 视频直播>直播+>实时音视频>应用管理 可以查看拥有的应用 ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. Only a single ID is supported. The ID can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and can be up to 55 characters in length. This ID is the identifier for the bypass relay and must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字符。此ID为旁路转推的标识，需保证唯一
parameters.name: task_id
